en.headline: Two women arrested after fight at Kwun Tong mall over girl being slapped
en.dek: Police detained a 68-year-old woman and a 34-year-old woman following a viral video of an altercation at the APM shopping centre play area on Wednesday afternoon.
body: Hong Kong police arrested two women on suspicion of assault after a dispute at the atrium of the APM shopping centre in Kwun Tong on Wednesday afternoon.

According to police sources, the incident began around 4:45 p.m. when a dispute between children over a play installation escalated. A viral video showed an elderly woman shoving and then slapping a five-year-old girl, after which another woman intervened and struck the first woman.

A 68-year-old woman and a 34-year-old woman were arrested on suspicion of assault occasioning actual bodily harm and common assault respectively. Three people, including the child, required hospital treatment. The case remains under investigation by Kwun Tong police.

zh.headline: 觀塘apm女童被掌摑混戰 警拘兩女
zh.dek: 周三下午觀塘apm商場遊戲區發生爭執，影片顯示阿婆推撞及掌摑女童後引發混戰，警方拘捕68歲及34歲女子。
body: 警方於周三下午在觀塘apm商場大堂處理一宗襲擊案，其後拘捕兩名女子。
消息指事件約下午4時45分發生，疑因兩名兒童爭玩遊戲設施起爭執。社交平台流傳影片顯示，一名年長女子推撞並掌摑一名五歲女童，女童跌倒後另一名女子上前理論並出手。
一名68歲女子及一名34歲女子分別涉嫌襲擊致造成身體傷害及普通襲擊被捕。包括女童在內共三人需送院治理。案件由觀塘警區調查。
